samples.description: Practical examples: login, save/load, remote config, edge functions, server shard (ExampleSupabaseScenarios + keyboard shortcuts).

Reference example for running PlayNANOO and the SDK side-by-side, then gradually migrating to the SDK. Integrate into your project code rather than using directly.
